 Testing Information 
 

 Testing Rules 
 Calculators and Other Computational Aids 
 
 You may not use books, notes, calculators, pocket organizers, slide-rules, abaci, or any other computational aids.
 Similarly you may not use graph paper, rulers, protractors, compasses, architectural tools, or any other drawing aids.
 In addition, communication devices such as laptops, PDAs, and cell phones are prohibited.
 

 Answer Format 
 
 Complete description of acceptable answers can be found in
 this PDF .
 

 Protests 
 
 If a student believes that an answer given on the answer key is incorrect,
 they must go to the designated Appeals Room and submit an appeal in writing.
 The deadline to do so will be announced on the day of the contest.
 

 
 Decisions of the HMMT coordinators are final.
